component 0: [["what is photosynthesis?", "Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants, algae, and chlorophyll-containing bacteria use sunlight to synthesize their own food from simple inorganic molecules, releasing oxygen as a byproduct."]]

[["what is glucose?", "Glucose is a type of carbohydrate that serves as a primary source of energy for many living organisms, including humans and plants. It is formed through the fixation of carbon dioxide (CO2) in photosynthesis and is released as a product of cellular respiration. Glucose has the chemical formula C6H12O6."]]
